description: This PHP source file defines a test fixture class 'WorkflowStateMachineFixture' used for setting up test data related to workflow state machines in the OrangeHRM project. It retrieves all WorkflowStateMachine entities from the database, extracts relevant properties from each, and prepares an array for testing purposes. The class extends 'AbstractFixture' and provides methods for data content and filename.
